questions.question: GraphQL N+1 problem và cách fix với DataLoader?

options.A: Resolver gọi DB cho mỗi item trong list → N+1 queries. DataLoader: batch và dedupe queries trong single tick
options.D: DataLoader không hoạt động với GraphQL

questions.explanation: posts query → 10 posts → mỗi post resolve author → 10 user queries = 11 queries. DataLoader: collect all user IDs trong current tick → 1 batched query. Memoize trong request scope.

questions.question: GraphQL vs REST — khi nào chọn GraphQL?

options.A: GraphQL: complex queries, multiple clients with different data needs, rapid iteration. REST: simple CRUD, file uploads, HTTP caching

questions.explanation: GraphQL lợi: over-fetching/under-fetching eliminated, strongly typed, introspection, single endpoint. Hại: complexity, N+1, HTTP caching khó, file upload phức tạp. REST: simpler, HTTP native caching, easier for public APIs.
